summary: Zoomcar Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of Series A units, not a special situation. The offering involves up to $5M of units (each $1,000 unit: one Series A convertible preferred share and one warrant). The initial closing raised ~$1.14M. The preferred shares convert at $0.05/share; warrants exercisable at $0.0625 for five years. This is a routine capital-raising transaction under Regulation D, not an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation category.
